name: What are common fee arrangements for trial attorneys in San Diego?

mainEntity.name: What are common fee arrangements for trial attorneys in San Diego?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most trial attorneys in San Diego use hourly billing, which ranges between $300–$800 per hour for civil cases. Contingency fees are common in personal injury trials, but rare in business litigation.brillantlaw+1​
